title: Kissed Filipino Yogurt Lechon
description: This sweet and savory dish is a twist on traditional lechon, featuring a long-fermentation dough and halal-friendly ingredients. Perfect for special occasions or family gatherings.

ingredients.name: All-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a gluten-free option for the halal diet

instructions: Combine yeast, warm water, sugar, and salt in a bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Add the yogurt and mix until smooth.
Gradually add the flour and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oval shape.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the dough with vegetable oil and let it rise for another 30 minutes.
Bake the dough for 45 minutes, or until it's golden brown.
While the dough is baking, heat the pineapple jam in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the dough is done, let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing it into wedges.
Brush the pineapple jam over the top of each wedge and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
